description: Count working days between two dates, excluding weekends and your own custom holidays, with a full breakdown.

faqs.a: Yes. Type each holiday as YYYY-MM-DD, one per line. Only holidays that fall on a weekday inside your date range are subtracted.
faqs.q: Can I add my own public holidays?

faqs.a: Both dates are included in the count.
faqs.q: Are the start and end dates inclusive?

faqs.a: Yes — the count updates for any dates, past or future, so it works for payroll, contracts and project planning.
faqs.q: Does it work for past dates too?

faqs.a: Use the optional weekend selector — choose Friday–Saturday or Thursday–Friday if that matches your country.
faqs.q: My weekend isn't Saturday–Sunday. What can I do?

howto: Pick a start date and an end date.
List any holidays, one YYYY-MM-DD per line.
Press Calculate to see business days plus the full breakdown.
title: Business Days Calculator
